title: fix(driver-sql): match SQL Server uniqueidentifier columns as their lower-case text in the text operators
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Nz8RqnG9tevj23FRpTaCFh)_

Fixes #31395

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：SQL Server 联邦表上，`uniqueidentifier`（GUID）列的「包含 / 开头是 / 结尾是 / 不包含 / like」过滤，现在按读出来的小写形式比较：`LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(36), 列))`。哪些列是 GUID，由驱动第一次在该对象上用到文本过滤时读远端目录（`INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS`）得知，按对象缓存一次。
2. 为什么改：读出时 GUID 已统一为小写（#31327），但子串过滤比较的是 SQL Server 自己的大写文本，从界面复制的小写片段查不到任何行。
3. 风险与回滚：只影响 SQL Server 的 GUID 列；`nvarchar` 列与其它方言编译出的 SQL 一字不变（有对照测试）。行为变化：区分大小写的运算符改为按小写读出形式比较，原先能命中的大写片段（如 `$startsWith: '3F2504E0'`）现在不命中，`$icontains` / `$ilike` 两种写法都命中。目录读失败时不记录、下次再读，期间按旧方式比较。回滚即还原本 PR。
4. 先看：`sql-driver-field-mapping.ts` 的 `primeMssqlGuidColumns`（何时读目录、读哪些对象），再看 `sql-driver-predicate-emitters.ts` 的 `mssqlGuidTextMatch` / `mssqlGuidLikePattern` 与 `applyLike` 的分流，最后 `sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts` 的 `guidColumn` 判定。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts`，34 条全绿（其中 19 条是本卡新增的编译期 pin）。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地；大写片段的答案变化写在 open questions 里，由席位裁定。

## What changes

On SQL Server a `uniqueidentifier` reads back lower-case (`lowerCaseGuids`, #31327), while every text operator compared the column's own text, which SQL Server renders upper-case. A lower-case fragment copied from a read matched nothing. Route chosen: **compare `LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(36), col))`** (not a refusal), so the text operators match the value a read answers.

- **Which columns are GUIDs: the remote catalog, never the comparand.** A federated object declares a `uniqueidentifier` column as a `text` / `lookup` field (`suggestFieldTypeForSqlType('uniqueidentifier', 'mssql')` is `text`), so the binding carries no type. New `SqlDriver#primeMssqlGuidColumns(object, where)` (body in `FieldMappingFacet`, beside the #31327 `primeMssqlPagingKey`) reads `introspectColumns` once per object and records the remote columns whose type is `uniqueidentifier` in `mssqlGuidColumnsByObject`. It asks only when `where` holds a text operator (`TEXT_OPERATORS`: the `$contains` family, `$icontains`, `$like` / `$ilike`), and also primes the object of every composed `ReadableIds` leaf in the tree, whose subquery compiles its own scope. A failed catalog read records nothing; the next read asks again.
- **Every read door primes before it compiles**, behind `if (this.isMssql)`: `findRows` (find / findOne), `count`, `aggregate`, `distinct`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`, `analyzeQuery` (explain), `findWithWindowFunctions`. The facet hosts gain `isMssql` / `primeMssqlGuidColumns` where they lacked them.
- **The compiler** (`applyFilterCondition`) computes `guidColumn` once per field from that set (by REMOTE column name, so an `external.columnMap` rename is honoured) and passes it to `applyLike` / `applyContainsLike` / `applyLikePattern`.
- **The emitters** (`sql-driver-predicate-emitters.ts`): `applyLike` / `applyLikePattern` route a GUID column on `mssql` to two new siblings, `mssqlGuidTextMatch` and `mssqlGuidLikePattern`: the mssql arm's construct (same escape, same `_BIN2` case-exact wrap, same `TRANSLATE` fold, same bound `ESCAPE`) with the column read as `mssqlGuidText` = `LOWER(CONVERT(nvarchar(36), col))`. `textMatchPredicate` and `likePatternPredicate` are byte-identical to `main` (the seat's serial note: #31394 rewrites `textMatchPredicate`), and no other dialect reads the flag.
- Equality and `$in` are untouched: SQL Server compares GUIDs by value.
- Docs: `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` § 8 SQL Server, the **GUIDs** bullet, states the choice (replacing "compare against SQL Server's upper-case text form; filter a GUID by equality").

Where the hunks sit (seat's request): `sql-driver-predicate-emitters.ts` — new `mssqlGuidText`, `mssqlGuidTextMatch`, `mssqlGuidLikePattern` after `mssqlAsciiLower`, and the dispatch line in `applyLike` / `applyLikePattern`; nothing inside `textMatchPredicate` or `likePatternPredicate`.

### Forced test edits

None. Every existing assertion stands unchanged; the tests below are additions.

## Tests

- `sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts` (compiled, no server; a top-level `describe` in the existing harness file): +19 pins. Every text operator on a GUID column in both fragment cases (`$contains` / `$startsWith` / `$endsWith` / `$notContains` / `$icontains` / `$like` / `$ilike`); the GUID key column; controls: an `nvarchar` column of the same table compiles exactly as an unprimed driver does, equality on a GUID column is `[RefId] = @p0`, and sqlite / postgres / mysql / oracle / unknown emit identically with and without the flag; the catalog is not asked without a text operator and asked once per object with one; a composed `ReadableIds` leaf primes its own object and its subquery matches the GUID key; a failed catalog read leaves the old construct and asks again. 34/34.
- `sql-driver-mssql-federation-conformance.test.ts` (live SQL Server cell): +17 cases in the `uniqueidentifier` block, each on `find` AND `count`, both fragment cases, plus an `nvarchar` control. Run against SQL Server 2022 (`mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest`) stood up in the card container: 229/229 with `OS_EXPECT_MSSQL_FEDERATION=1`. CI provisions no SQL Server cell, so CI runs these as the file's named skip.

| A1 | `applyLike` never routes to `mssqlGuidTextMatch` | 13 compiled pins (every `applyLike` operator on a GUID column, the key column, the ReadableIds subquery, the failed-read recovery) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Answer change for an upper-case fragment** (seat to rule, open question 1): the case-exact operators now follow the lower-case read form, so a fragment that matched SQL Server's upper-case rendering on `main` (`$startsWith: '3F2504E0'`) now matches nothing, and `$notContains` flips with it. No request is refused that was accepted, so `Clause-②: no` holds as the claim spells it; the answer set moves to agree with the read and with every other dialect, where a GUID is stored and compared as lower-case text.
- **Catalog read cost:** one `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS` read per object per driver lifetime, only when a filter uses a text operator. A remote `ALTER` that changes a column's type is not seen until the driver restarts (the same lifetime as the #31327 paging key).
- `service-analytics` (#31394) is the twin and is not touched here.

Three answered exit 3 (prerequisite, nothing measured) on the first pass and were re-run green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `spec check:skill-examples` after the closure build. `check:facade-delegation-only` is green: the new `SqlDriver` members are one-call stubs.
